mapper.select: select w.work_id, w.title, w.cover, w.author_id, w.work_type, w.upload_type, w.length_type, w.summary, w.price, w.trade_type, w.trade_enabled, w.word_count, w.episode_count, w.duration, w.is_free, w.preview_enabled, w.preview_episodes, w.status, w.is_copyrighted, w.quality_level, w.view_count, w.favorite_count, w.sale_count, w.rating, w.create_time, u.nick_name as author_name, r.last_read_chapter_id, ch.chapter_no as last_read_chapter_no, r.last_read_at from sys_work w left join sys_user u on u.user_id = w.author_id left join sys_bookshelf_record r on r.user_id = #{userId} and r.work_id = w.work_id left join sys_work_chapter ch on ch.chapter_id = r.last_read_chapter_id left join ( select o.work_id, max(coalesce(o.complete_time, o.pay_time, o.created_at)) as acquire_time from sys_order o where o.buyer_id = #{userId} and o.status = 'completed' group by o.work_id ) o on o.work_id = w.work_id left join ( select a.work_id, max(a.start_date) as acquire_time from sys_copyright_authorization a where a.licensee_id = #{userId} and a.status = 'active' and a.start_date <= curdate() and (a.end_date is null or a.end_date >= curdate()) group by a.work_id ) a on a.work_id = w.work_id where (o.work_id is not null or a.work_id is not null) and w.is_deleted = 0 order by coalesce(o.acquire_time, a.acquire_time) desc, w.work_id desc
mapper.insert: insert into sys_bookshelf_record (user_id, work_id, add_source, is_deleted, last_read_chapter_id, last_read_at, created_at, updated_at) values (#{userId}, #{workId}, 'read', 0, #{chapterId}, now(), now(), now()) on duplicate key update last_read_chapter_id = values(last_read_chapter_id), last_read_at = values(last_read_at), add_source = 'read', updated_at = values(updated_at)
